title: OptimAL – performance still matters
summary: OptimAL is a structured Microsoft performance initiative for BC partners and ISVs that combines maturity assessment, skills training, telemetry analysis, and hands-on code optimization. The program addresses how most BC performance issues stem from partner code rather than the platform, with participants achieving dramatic improvements like reducing batch job runtime from 5+ hours to under 20 minutes or improving page load times by 93%.
key_points: OptimAL is a Microsoft-led program delivered by Dev Center partner Ciellos, not a third-party product
Most BC performance problems come from partner code, outdated patterns, and anti-patterns rather than the platform itself
The program includes assessment, skills development, telemetry analysis, and hands-on optimization with documented results
Participants shifted from reactive to proactive performance thinking and increased focus on telemetry
Escape Room format teaches performance optimization by having participants fix common mistakes found in real BC code

quotes.text: most BC performance issues don't come from the platform. They don't come from the baseapp. They come from our code.
quotes.why_it_matters: This is the core insight that OptimAL addresses - performance problems are typically in partner implementations, not BC itself
